# Automatically Generated Document Name

**Reported Issue**

The user notices that the document name in SPUMA keeps changing, even though it was previously entered manually.

---

**Solution**

**Automatic document name generation** may be enabled in SPUMA. This is configured by the administrator.

1. The document name is automatically generated based on **selected fields** (e.g. Business Partner, date, number).
2. If you complete or modify these fields, the system **overwrites the document name**.

To find out **how document names are generated in your company**, contact your administrator for details about the configuration.

---
